synopsis: A man reaches for honey and a thick amber rope climbs up the spoon and arcs toward the cabinet above the counter.
narration: Tried to get honey for my tea and it went up the spoon and onto the cabinet. Third jar this week. Anyone seen this?

shots.prompt: An open glass jar of golden honey with a plain metal teaspoon resting inside it. a thick amber rope of honey travelling upward against gravity, glossy and unbroken along its whole length. The frame remains completely locked from a tight side angle across the kitchen counter. A lived-in home kitchen counter: dark speckled stone-look surface with faint scratches and a few crumbs near the edge, a tiled backsplash behind, and morning daylight from a side window mixing with a warm under-cabinet glow. Hands wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt rest on the counter beside the open jar, the jar filling the centre of the frame. A thick amber rope of honey climbing the spoon runs from the surface of the honey up along the metal handle and into the air above the rim, glossy and steady in the warm light.
shots.violation_observation: a thick amber rope of honey travels upward along the spoon handle
shots.state_carry: a thick amber rope of honey climbing the spoon
